stem_book: 20 g of ammonium nitrate (NH₄NO₃) is dissolved in 125 g of water in a coffee-cup calorimeter, the temperature of which falls from 296.5 K to 286.4 K. Find the value of 'q' (heat gained, with sign) for the calorimeter. (Treat heat capacity of water as the heat capacity of the calorimeter and its contents; specific heat of water = 4.184 J g⁻¹ K⁻¹.) (in kJ)
reason: Printed key 5.28 drops the sign: the calorimeter cools, so q(calorimeter) = −5.28 kJ (+5.28 kJ is q for the dissolution); added specific heat of water and 'with sign'
